removal_suggestion: No safe removal exists: selecting exactly k mutually exclusive configurations in three categories is intrinsically an exact-cover instance. Changing it would change the task rather than remove incidental wording.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Models the instance as exact cover over 3k component columns, with each approved configuration as a row covering one mold, one dye, and one packaging line.

common_affordance: The exact-cover equivalence between choosing k mutually disjoint triples and covering all mold, dye, and packaging columns exactly once.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The submitted implementation terminates with a runtime error, independently of the mathematical formulation.
It uses straightforward backtracking over configurations for a three-dimensional matching problem, which can take exponential time and exceeds the limit.
Its matching structure is essentially a two-dimensional mold-dye matching and does not correctly enforce the simultaneous packaging-line constraint.
